audit_scope: All lexical cards in src/data.ts: source/metadata coverage; only four user-supplied screenshots visually inspected in this pass; no blanket photo quality certification.
rubric: Single unmistakable primary subject at smartphone width
Natural warm neutral human expressions with clean contemporary everyday environments
Bright neutral uncluttered background, sharp focus and useful framing
No embedded translations, watermarks, crowd scenes or unrelated branding
Semantic accuracy for German headword, including family roles and singular nouns
Attribution and license provenance for third-party assets
Confirm actual image pixels and 1:1 phone crop before approving or deploying
